# DESK_F3_TABLE (generated by code/th_dync/defg_f3_table.py; DESK coverage F3 = DESCRIPTIVE TABLE ONLY, change 32; research only)

Styles (A rows = one book alone, same entries as the reference only where the gate keeps them: day-level sums are compared, not trades): DK3MAIN (bracket + loss side), DK4MAIN (ratchet, no target), DK4REF (ratchet + own target ceiling), DK5 (bank half, run half), DK6 (ratchet + ABORT), DK7 (bracket + near-target guard). Reference = the book on its fixed bracket (TL3_DX_<S>_<MF>_fix_A) on the same months. Day = ET + 7 h date of the exit (as ar_desk); P&L = gross - 4.84 x lots; per session the delta (style - bracket) is summed over the session's books per day.
